LanguageData.ResearchInflation_RateTip: Every finished project raises the cost of all remaining research by this much, compounding. Points already earned are kept.
LanguageData.ResearchInflation_CapTip: Costs never rise above this multiple of their starting cost. Drag fully left for no cap.
LanguageData.ResearchInflation_ThresholdTip: Projects with a vanilla cost below this are not inflated and do not raise the multiplier.
LanguageData.ResearchInflation_EraModeTip: Optionally change each era's starting cost before inflation applies.
LanguageData.ResearchInflation_EraOffTip: Choose "Add to vanilla" or "Replace vanilla" under Era costs to edit this.
LanguageData.ResearchInflation_EraAddTip: Added to the vanilla cost of every {0} project.
LanguageData.ResearchInflation_EraReplaceTip: Starting cost of every {0} project, in place of its vanilla cost. Minimum 1.
